summary: Gold extended gains as US inflation data that was in-line with expecations eased concerns about Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes.

title: EM Currencies Trade Mixed as Inflation Fails to Shift Fed Bets
summary: An early rally in emerging-market currencies fizzled on Wednesday after the dollar reversed losses triggered by tame US inflation data, as investors maintained bets that the Federal Reserve could raise interest rates at its next meeting.

title: QTS Holds Calls Ahead of Possible $2.85 Billion Bond Sale
summary: Subsidiaries of QualityTech LP are holding fixed income investor calls ahead of a potential bond offering that may raise about $2.85 billion in the market’s latest data-center financing.

title: Yen Trades Near 160 Level as Traders Watch for Intervention
summary: The yen edged closer to the key level of 160 per dollar on Wednesday, keeping investors on the lookout for more intervention by officials in the foreign-exchange market.

title: Behind CME’s Plan for 24/7 Silver Futures To Draw Retail
summary: CME Group is preparing to expand its 24/7 trading hours to include the 100-ounce silver futures contract, pending regulatory approval, following the recent launch of its around-the-clock one-ounce gold futures contract. Jin Hennig, CME Group Managing Director and Global Head of Metals, explained that strong retail demand and significant weekend trading volumes in gold futures, exceeding $200 million in notional value over recent weekends, have driven the decision to extend 24/7 trading to silver. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Isabelle Lee on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: S&P 500 Rises to Brink of Record on Tame Inflation: Markets Wrap
summary: Stocks rose to a striking distance of a record after the latest inflation report matched expectations, easing concerns about imminent Federal Reserve rate increases.

title: US Stocks Rise on AI Trade as Market Awaits More Inflation Data
summary: US stocks closed near all-time highs, led by the technology sector, after a subdued inflation reading helped ease interest-rate hike concerns.

title: AI Cloud Provider Lambda Prices Loan for Nvidia-Tied Chip Deal
summary: Lambda Inc., an AI cloud-computing provider backed by Nvidia Corp., wrapped up a $926 million leveraged-loan deal as that market becomes a new front in the borrowing binge to finance the artificial intelligence buildout.

summary: The world of sports has become a multi-trillion dollar industry and teams continue to change hands at huge valuations. They discuss the sale of the Los Angeles Lakers and the Seattle Seahawks. Bloomberg's Michelle Davis reports on "Bloomberg Deals." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Cava CEO on Cyclospora, Dining Trends and Growth Outlook
summary: Cava co-founder and CEO Brett Schulman says the company has not been impacted by the cyclospora outbreak. Speaking on "Bloomberg The Close," Schulman also comments on recent dining trends and the company's growth outlook. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Two Sigma’s Overdeck Offered Wife $633 Million, Her Lawyer Says
summary: Two Sigma Investments’ billionaire co-founder John Overdeck schemed to leave his wife Laura “with as little as possible,” her lawyer said as the couple’s divorce trial began, an amount she pegged at $633 million.

title: US Sells 10-Year Debt at Highest Yields Since Financial Crisis
summary: A $42 billion auction of 10-year US Treasuries resulted in the highest yield for the benchmark securities since 2007, luring decent appetite from investors who’ve been demanding more compensation to finance the US government.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 12
summary: Oil swung between gains and losses as traders parsed a barrage of data from leading energy forecasters amid little sign of a breakthrough between Iran and the US over the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Colombia Coffee Exports Partially Resume After Quake
summary: Colombia partially resumed coffee exports through Buenaventura port, on the country’s the Pacific coast, after the earthquake, according to the Gustavo Gómez, head of the country’s coffee exporters association, Asoexport.

title: ‘Call Her Daddy’ Host Raises Money at $500M Valuation
summary:
Bloomberg's Ashley Carman joins Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg Deals." Unwell, the media company founded by popular podcast host Alex Cooper, has received an investment from Hollywood super agent Patrick Whitesell that values the firm at $500 million, according to people familiar with the deal.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: CEOs Concerned About the Consumer, Says Rebecca Homkes
summary: Rebecca Homkes, lecturer at the London School of Economics, said that all CEOs are concerned about the state of the consumer, but how just concerned or optimistic they are varies by industry. Homkes described the difference in experience as a continuum of companies that deal in 'dirt,' meaning infrastructure or supply chain, to companies that deal directly with the consumer economy.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Calif. AG Calls Paramount’s Threat to Leave ‘Blackmail’
summary: Bloomberg's Josh Sisco joins Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg Deals." California Attorney General Rob Bonta called reports that Paramount Skydance plans to leave the state if its top lawyer doesn’t settle a lawsuit challenging the company’s planned merger with Warner Bros. Discovery “blackmail’ in a post on social media Tuesday. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Wendy’s Shares Jumps On Peltz Bid News
summary: Bloomberg's Matt Monks joins Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg Deals." Shares of Wendy’s jumped to their highest in seven weeks after the Financial Times reported that Nelson Peltz’s Trian Fund Management is preparing a bid to take the struggling fast-food chain private. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Walter Sells Lakers, Seeks Cash to Pay Loans Amid DOJ Probe
summary: Billionaire Mark Walter’s firm is in talks with investors to raise money to help pay down loans on the books of its insurers that had drawn scrutiny from the Justice Department, according to people familiar with the matter.
